pop.Dataset Description:
Estimates, total number of people per grid-cell. The dataset is available to download in Geotiff format at a resolution of 3 arc (approximately 100m at the equator). The projection is Geographic Coordinate System, WGS84. The units are number of people per pixel. The mapping approach is Random Forest-based dasymetric redistribution.

More information can be found in the [Release Statement](https://data.worldpop.org/repo/prj/Global_2015_2030/R2025A/doc/Global2_Release_Statement_R2025A_v1.pdf)

Please note that these data represent 2025 Alpha release versions, constructed in September 2025
pop.Methodology: Methodology information can be found in the [Release Statement](https://data.worldpop.org/repo/prj/Global_2015_2030/R2025A/doc/Global2_Release_Statement_R2025A_v1.pdf)
pop.Caveats:
Disclaimer: The dataset currently represents an alpha version (R2025A) product and may change over the coming year as improvements are made.

Data for earlier dates is available directly from WorldPop

age_structures.Dataset Description:
Estimates of total number of people per grid square broken down by gender and age groupings (including 0-1 and by 5-year up to 90+) for {countryname}, R2025A version v1. The dataset is available to download in Geotiff format at a resolution of 3 arc (approximately 100m at the equator). The projection is Geographic Coordinate System, WGS84. The units are estimated number of male, female or both in each age group per grid square. 

More information can be found in the [Release Statement](https://data.worldpop.org/repo/prj/Global_2015_2030/R2025A/doc/Global2_Release_Statement_R2025A_v1.pdf)

Please note that these data represent 2025 Alpha release versions, constructed in September 2025

**File Descriptions**

*iso*\_*gender*\_*age group*\_*year*\_*type*\_*resolution*\_*release*\_*version*.tif

*iso*

Three-letter country code

*gender*

m = male, f = female, t = both genders

*age group*

* 00 = age group 0 to 12 months
* 01 = age group 1 to 4 years
* 05 = age group 5 to 9 years
* 90 = age 90 years and over

*year*

Year that the population represents

*type*

CN = [Constrained](https://www.worldpop.org/methods/top_down_constrained_vs_unconstrained/)

*resolution*

Resolution of the data e.q. 100m = 3 arc (approximately 100m at the equator)

*release*

WorldPop release e.g. R2025A

*version*

Version of the release e.g. v1. 1km files have an additional UA segment before the version, e.g. R2025A\_UA\_v1

*T\_F* and *T\_M*

Total female and total male population across all age groups (100m files only)
